_meta.purpose: A9 — per-client inventory of endorsements on file, consumed by endorsements.py to decide which endorsement PDFs to attach to outgoing COI delivery emails. Kept as a SIBLING of coi_client_registry.json on purpose: the client registry is injected verbatim into every classifier API call, and endorsement data must not bloat or perturb that prompt.
_meta.source: training/endorsements/endorsement_inventory.json + ENDORSEMENT_INVENTORY.md (A9 scaffold, 2026-07-03, incl. Alex's 07-02/07-03 reinstatement confirmations) — see those files for full evidence citations.

status_values.blanket: Endorsement applies automatically to any party required by written contract — safe to attach the endorsement PDF for any certificate holder.
status_values.scheduled: Endorsement names specific parties only. NEVER auto-attach for a new holder — a new carrier change endorsement is needed first; surface a producer flag instead.
status_values.none: Confirmed NOT on file (carrier endorsement schedule checked). Demanding parties need a producer conversation, not an attachment.
status_values.unverified: Existence/blanket status not confirmed at the endorsement-form level. Treat as not attachable until verified.

_meta.pdf_convention: PDFs live at endorsements/<client_id>/<pdf_filename>. Attach logic requires status=blanket AND the file actually present on disk; a blanket entry whose PDF is not yet on file produces a producer note instead of an attachment.
hard_rules: AJF Roofing: historical certs showing GAF as additional insured on every COI were a MISTAKE (Alex, 2026-07-03). Never encode any GAF-on-AJF pattern anywhere — this registry is holder-agnostic by design and must stay that way.
